intro: Our aim is to create new techniques spanning process modeling, simulation, design, optimization and control, data analysis and decision support, and computational and applied mathematics.

The world economic trend and developing industries have led to significant growth of process systems engineering in renewable energy and in new process integration and improvement. Although process modeling and simulation have become accurate, fast and inexpensive enough to reduce reliance on plant scale-up, process design and control remain an important framework for solving the bottlenecks of a process.

Our research focuses on dynamic modeling, simulation and optimization for a class of complex chemical processes and energy systems. The mathematical models consist of nonlinear ordinary differential, differential-algebraic and partial differential equations, for which numerical analysis and solution techniques are essential.

areas.title: Hydrogen & Fuel Cells
areas.text: We design and optimize routes to low-carbon hydrogen: gasification of biomass and waste, reforming of glycerol and methanol, chemical looping, and hydrogen liquefaction that recovers cold energy from LNG regasification. On the use side, we model on-board methanol-to-hydrogen processors for fuel cell vehicles and SOFC/gas turbine cogeneration systems.

areas.title: Carbon Capture & Low-Carbon Industry
areas.text: Process models for cutting emissions from heavy industry and power generation. Our studies cover amine-based CO2 capture with heat integration, low-carbon and oxygen blast furnaces, decarbonized cement production, oxy-fuel and IGCC power plants, and chemical- and calcium-looping systems, each assessed on energy, cost and emissions together.

areas.title: Biomass, Microalgae & Waste Conversion
areas.text: Turning biomass, plastic waste, sewage sludge, and fats, oils and grease into fuels, chemicals and power. The work spans gasification and co-gasification modeling, polygeneration plant design, hydrothermal liquefaction and microalgae biorefineries, including microalgae-based wastewater treatment for pig farming.

areas.title: Renewable Energy & Biofuel Systems
areas.text: Energy and exergy analysis of geothermal and organic Rankine cycle systems, solar thermal collectors and dryers, and the optimal dispatch of hybrid energy systems for low-carbon communities, alongside engine studies of biodiesel and other biofuels.

areas.title: Process Design, Intensification & Control
areas.text: Reactive, extractive and pressure-swing distillation designed for flexibility as well as cost, chromatographic separation of multicomponent mixtures, green solvent production through process intensification, and plantwide control of industrial units.

areas.title: Life Cycle & Environmental Assessment
areas.text: Life cycle assessment carried out side by side with techno-economic analysis, so that a process is judged on its environmental impact as well as its cost. Recent subjects include microalgae-to-biofuel chains, methanol and hydrogen supply for fuel cell vehicles, cement production and fluid catalytic cracking units.

areas.title: AI & Data-Driven Modeling
areas.text: Machine learning where first-principles models are slow or incomplete: physics-informed neural networks for waste gasification, surrogate models for process optimization under uncertainty, emission prediction for gas-fired power plants, and remaining-useful-life estimation for industrial equipment.
